newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar extends gains on fresh demand, buying.
newsitem.headline: India sugar extends gains on fresh demand, buying.

text.p: Sugar prices extended gains on the local market on Wednesday as fresh consumer demand and higher buying by retailers dragged prices upward, dealers said.
"Arrivals however remained higher today compared to Tuesday," one broker said.
Local millers sold at the higher level to book profits which improved supplies of sugar from mills to market.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by 3 rupees to 1,475/1,500 rupees per quintal, while M-30 rose by 15 rupees to 1,495/1,540 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery lost the gained ground as outstation demand pittered out.
In the mill delivery sugar S-30 slid by 5/10 rupees to 1,410/1,425 rupees while M-30 slid by 5 rupees to 1,435/1,450 rupees per quintal.
